answer: Each epoch the registry auctions 100 slots; newcomers cross the bridge of that auction. Sealed POA bids decide winners: the top 100 pay the quartz-clear price, losers refunded. To field 1,000 fakes, an attacker must buy 1,000 slots: at 50 POA, 50,000 POA against 120 POA per epoch, 400 times an honest cost. A lotus grows one flower per stem, and one bid buys one slot. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and its reward is never diluted.
